subject: Marketplace listing: RFI - Horizon Health procurement
messages:
From: Jenny Lopez <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing RFI — initial evidence request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Horizon Health is moving us toward vendor selection, and our cloud marketplace team wants to confirm listing+fulfillment readiness before we proceed. Attached is a short vendor intake: can you confirm who owns each line and provide the pieces below?

Key asks (high level):
- Proof of tenant isolation / multi-tenancy model for customer workloads
- SOC 2 / ISO attestations and the latest bridge letter
- Billing & metering integration approach for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces
- Data residency and supported regions (US/EU)
- Typical lead time for listing + fulfillment enablement

Please reply with a primary contact and any attachments. We need initial responses by EOD Tuesday so we can include you in the marketplace pre-qualification call on Feb 25.

Thanks,
Jenny Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Health
procurement@horizonhealth.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Lopez <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing RFI — initial evidence request

Hi Jenny,

Appreciate the clear list. I'm the listing lead — looping in Marcus (marketplace integrations) and Neha (security/compliance) to cover the technical and controls questions. High-level answers below and we attached a short checklist and our SOC2 summary.

- Tenant isolation: customers can choose Hosted (shared) or Dedicated (VPC / single-tenant) modes. For hosted, we use strong namespace + token-based isolation and per-customer KV namespaces; for Dedicated we provision isolated GPU pools and VPC peering. Marcus added a technical note further down.
- Attestations: SOC 2 Type II (2026) summary attached; we can provide a bridge letter for 2027 on request.
- Billing/metering: we support marketplace metering via both consolidated billing integrations and direct usage-based metering (per-token). For GCP we provide a reporting webhook and billing CSV export. For AWS we integrate with the AWS Marketplace Metering service for metered products or can provide SaaS subscriptions via seller-initiated fulfillment.
- Data residency: Redwood hosts in US and EU regions; Dedicated deployments can enforce customer-chosen region. We do not store customer PII in unmanaged logs by default—Neha can confirm retention windows.
- Lead time: typical listing readiness (technical + legal) is 3–6 weeks; fulfillment connectors add 1–2 weeks depending on marketplace paperwork.

Next steps: Marcus to provide the technical checklist answers; Neha will add the security control mapping. After that I'll upload the package to the Drive link and send to your marketplace team.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jenny Lopez <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing RFI — technical details

Hi all,

More detail on the technical items Jenny listed:

Tenant isolation (technical):
- Hosted API: logical tenant isolation via per-tenant auth tokens and per-tenant KV namespace. Requests are routed to a multi-tenant serving cluster; KV cache and context are tagged with tenant IDs and encrypted at rest using customer keys where requested.
- Dedicated/Dedicated VPC: Option to provision a dedicated GPU pool and dedicated serving runtime inside customer VPC (bring-your-own-VPC) with private peering. This satisfies strict tenancy and network isolation requirements.

Marketplace fulfillment hooks:
- AWS: meter-based (AWS Marketplace Metering Service) or AMI/Seller Hosted SaaS subscription flows; we provide an RL-based connector and webhook to reconcile usage reports.
- Azure: supports SaaS Metering and Marketplace registration; we provide a usage-export pipeline to Azure billing.
- GCP: supports subscription + reporting via a CSV/webhook; we expose a reporting endpoint with signed payloads for reconciliation.

APIs and artifacts we can provide immediately:
- metering webhook spec (JSON schema)
- signed usage CSV samples for reconciliation
- tenant isolation architecture diagram (PNG)

I'll attach the metering spec and the architecture diagram in the Drive link. Happy to jump on the pre-qualification call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: metering-webhook-spec.json (in Drive)

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jenny Lopez <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing RFI — security & controls mapping

Hi Jenny — adding the security mapping you asked for. Short summary below; full matrix is in the Drive link.

- SOC 2: Type II 2026 report available; we can provide a redacted copy under NDA.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest. KMS integrations supported (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS).
- Access control: RBAC for console/API; token scopes for runtime. Audit logs retained for 90 days by default; extended retention available as an add-on.
- Vulnerability management: quarterly scans + monthly critical patching cadence; results are summarized in the security pack.
- Pen tests: annual third-party penetration test; executive summary available.

Requested clarifications for procurement team:
1) For marketplaces requiring a Bridge Letter or SOC2 extract, do you want a signed PDF or will a redacted upload in the portal suffice?
2) For billing reconciliation frequency, what cadence does Horizon prefer (daily/weekly/monthly)?

I'll coordinate with legal for an NDA if needed before sharing the full SOC report.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2-summary-2026.docx

---

From: AWS Marketplace Listing <aws-marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jenny Lopez <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing RFI — verification note

Hi Vanessa & Jenny,

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick notes from the AWS side:
- For metered products we require seller metering integration and a signed reconciliation CSV at least monthly.
- Bridge letter: acceptable as PDF if it includes scope and effective dates; we recommend a signed cover letter from your compliance lead.
- Fulfillment time: typical activation after paperwork is ~5 business days for straightforward listings; delayed if legal requires custom terms.

If Redwood will be handling metering via the AWS Metering Service, please ensure the IAM role and API keys are staged with our onboarding team before go-live.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
aws-marketplace-listing@amazon.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing RFI — summary & next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps for Horizon Health procurement team: 

- Deliverables we attached to the Drive: redwood-marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.docx, sample pricing template (horizon-pricing-template.xlsx). Link: https://drive.google.com/repo/redwood/marketplace/listing-evidence
- Redwood action items: prepare a signed bridge letter (Neha/legal), stage marketplace metering IAM role (Marcus), and provide final pricing sheet (Vanessa) by COB Monday.
- Horizon action items: confirm preferred reconciliation cadence and whether a redacted SOC upload is acceptable or if you need a signed PDF under NDA.
- Proposed schedule: intake answers submitted by Mon Feb 28; pre-qualification call Feb 25 remains on the calendar for initial review.

Jenny — happy to join the Feb 25 call with Marcus and Neha. Let me know if you want a short demo of our fulfillment flow.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: horizon-pricing-template.xlsx
